g.text: had another one of those nightmares...
and i'd go to talk to arthur about it like last time but um....
i had another one of those solawful nightmares and it had me up all night staring at the wall
he was kinda really IN it and that is kinda awkward to be like 'hey buddy yeah so about this terrible dream i had where you MURDERED ME'
this one was terrible and i just need to talk to somebody about it before it bores a hole in my head
you around i got a favor to ask of my favorite-est cupcake in the whole wide world
you around i got a favor to ask of my bestest best bestie best bestie
so i was wondering if we could talk about it... if that's okay...?
Yeah, of course. Talk me through it.
so those nightmares i get well i had a freakin doozy of one last night had me up staring at the wall for hours
i um... i don't think i've mentioned this? maybe i have? i dunno anymore... but i get these awful nightmares...
this one was worse than usual and i was just wondering if you didn't mind
i'm not a soldier, not like the others, and i just... i know scaldra are the baddies and all but they're also PEOPLE
i just need to talk to somebody about it before it bores a hole in my head
and i just i see their faces in my dreams staring at me and i can't... i don't know what to do and then..
thanks hon, that means the world to me
thanks, that means the world to me
so i know when i tried to tell you what happened to me after entrati gave me that vial
i just need to tell somebody about the nightmare i had last night before it bores a hole in my head
i just... couldn't quite get through the story
so i told you how i worked at the oro but i never told you how i got HERE here...
i don't think i ever told you how i got into this mess and if i don't none of this nightmare's gonna make any sense at all so here goes
and i'm so sorry about that it's just so hard for me to talk about
so while i was working at the reactor entrati hacked my computer and started sending me messages
gonna just try to make this as quick as possible ridgenotes style
asking for specs and deets on the reactor core and kept saying the FATE OF THE UNIVERSE depended on it
so i was an intern for the O.R.O. at the nuclear power plant in their software dev department working on information security
guess i'll do what normal people do with their trauma
but after everything you've told me about duviri i... think you'll understand
but none of the nightmare will make sense if i don't... tell you the rest of what happened, so...
I WAS AN INTERN WHAT THE HELL WAS I SUPPOSED TO DO
and go develop a drinking problem
yeah so i gave him the stuff and then...well, the ORO found out, i still don't know how, and they sent scaldra after me
one day i get these weird hacked messages directly to my desktop with a big red pixelated eyeball asking for intel on the nuclear reactor and saying if i don't the UNIVERSE IS DOOMED
look i get it i'm a grown-ass adult and i can handle my own shit
i shot the vial into my leg
as i was running for my life i got an address texted to my pager and i went there, and... there was dr. e, vial in hand, and said to use it if shit ever hit the fan
like what was i supposed to do?! no pressure... of course now i know it was doktor f dicking around with me and he was using future tech but at the time i was like ::gasp:: MAGIC!!
but correct me if i'm wrong part of dating a person is that you're supposed to be there when they need you
well okay HE didn't say that can you imagine entrati saying "IF THE SHIT HITS THE FAN" lmao
sooooo i gave him what he wanted and then the oro found out (still don't know how) and they sent scaldra after me
so yeah sorry but i think i need to take a break from this US thing if this is how you're going to be when i need help
the memory of it still wakes me up sometimes
well... shit did hit the fan, and... this is where... this is where it gets really hard to talk about but i gotta otherwise it won't make any sense...
Wait, hold on, just like that?
like ants crawling through your veins, under your skin, inside your eyeballs, biting you everywhere
too many legs inside your organs, scratching, skittering, trying to escape
i had to get it OUT
GET THEM ALL OUT OF ME
i don't even really think i saw the scaldra regiment that had me cornered...
ever leave a pork chop on the grill for too long?
the smell of charred meat is...
Stay with me. You're okay. One word at a time. Breathe.
Holy shit, dude... I'm so, so sorry... was it the electricity?
breatheyeahbreathe okay yeah i can do this thanks yeah okay
then somebody FUGGIN PUNCHED ME IN THE FUGGIN FACE
half an hour earlier and it would've broken my nose or left me sitting on the ground in a heap
but i'm filled with crawling biting skittering insects and i can't stop them and i can't stop the killing and i CAN'T STOP
now, i know it was arthur... but i didn't even see him, then... it was all just a blur...
i remember his voice though "focus on me"
i don't... remember a lot of what came after that...
i just remember sitting on the ground in an alley, weeping...
arthur holding me tight like i was coming down from some lsd trip
and i remember the charred corpses of the scaldra
staring at me from their empty and burned-out eye sockets
mouths open in screams i can still hear when i'm asleep
that's... well... a bunch of those scars he has?
in my nightmare last night, we fought like normal, but... instead, i killed him, too
electrocuted him and burned him to bits like the scaldra
but he didn't stay dead, eyes exploded in his sockets, lips blackened, and he kept talking to me
"this is all your fault" "we're all dead because of you" "if only you were smarter" "if only you were faster"
it just kept ringing in my head though, one phrase "all my fault" if i hadn't given entrati the info on the reactor...
He would've gotten it another way without you. He set you up for this. I'd bet money he gave you up to the O.R.O.
None of this is your fault, Amir. None of it.
that's not true i know for a fact that if i had done better some of this could have been avoided
I would bet my orbiter that Entrati had you all picked out to be exactly where you are, when you were there, for exactly these reasons.
But that's life. We all make mistakes. We're just unique in the fact that we get a chance for "do-overs." Most people aren't so lucky.
Sure, but you're carrying all the guilt on your shoulders when YOU weren't the person pulling the strings.
The only thing we can ever do is the best we can in the moment we're in.
You were thrown into a terrible situation and changed in a way that nobody could possibly be prepared for.
They don't make a manual for "getting partially turned into a warframe in 1999."
thanks for just letting me vent and talking me through this
now i gotta go crash i'm fuggin exhausted
